payload.timeline: Frames at 30 fps from the assembled voice (runs/child-peek/voice/timed-voice.json): sh1 0, sh2 192, sh3 312, sh4 372, sh5 447. Anchors below are relative, so they survive a re-timed voice.
payload.idea: One source, two perspectives. The engine in sh3 is the scooter itself, heard far away (quieter, duller, more reverberant), so it can pass for Dad's car. On the cut to sh4 we hear it close and it is plainly a scooter. The twist is fair because the sound never lied.

locations.note: Continuous under all five shots, unchanged across cuts, so it reads as one place. Thins to room tone only in sh5.

music.note: Silent until 'Even better', so the one warm moment arrives with it.

sounds.perspective: From the street, near the post at frame left
sounds.reason: Marks dusk, and it is the light the scooter will later round

sounds.what: Fingertips tapping the metal rail, a few light taps
sounds.duration: about 2 s, ending before the cut to sh3
sounds.reason: A small sound of waiting, kept clear of the cue word 'car'; matches her performance notes

sounds.what: A small engine approaching, distant and indistinct: could be a car
sounds.perspective: Offscreen, screen-left, far then nearer; heard from the balcony (Mia's ears): low-passed and reverberant
sounds.reason: Plants Dad's car without words. The same recording as fx4, processed for distance

sounds.what: The same engine, close: a scooter's higher whine settling to idle
sounds.perspective: Street level, close to the scooter
sounds.reason: The sound changes character exactly on the reveal cut
The beat 'Not Dad' follows; the line lands after the squeak, not on the cut
Clears the air: a beat of room tone only, then 'Even better'

payload.levels: Tiers: narration, then featured effects, then ambience, then room tone. Nothing featured sits on a cue word. Mix to -16 LUFS integrated, peaks at or below -1 dBTP.
payload.phoneCheck: The engine and scooter must be recognisable by their mid and high range (whine, not throb); phone speakers lose the low end.

checks.eyesClosed: Evening and distant traffic; a light switching on; small tapping (waiting); an engine coming, far away; it arrives close and it's a scooter, brakes; it stops; quiet; 'Even better' and music.
checks.soundOff: The empty parking bay in sh1 and the single light in sh3 carry the set-up; checked on the boards in am-mcd.3.

sourcing.status: Not sourced. Downloads need the human's approval. Allowed: owned, CC0, or CC BY with attribution (no NC or ND variants; human decision, 2026-11-24). Each sound gets a provenance record with its licence and attribution text.
sourcing.howToFind: freesound.org (check the licence on each sound page: CC0 or CC BY are fine; skip NC, ND and Sampling+). Or record the effects yourself on a phone.

queries.fx1: streetlight hum OR street lamp buzz
queries.fx3/fx4: scooter OR moped pass by idle (one recording serves both: fx3 is the same sound low-passed, quieter and reverberant)
queries.fx5: scooter brake squeak OR bicycle brake squeal short
queries.fx6: scooter engine off OR moped switch off
queries.ambience: suburb evening ambience distant traffic birds
